pages.text: The Silk Touch Upgrade enables silk touch functionality in the Destructor. RS2 brings improved block state handling and better compatibility with modded blocks.
Features:$(li)Enhanced silk touch functionality$(li)Improved block state preservation$(li)Better modded block compatibility$(li)Optimized power consumption$(li)Works seamlessly with RS2 systems
To use the Silk Touch Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a Destructor$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Destructor will now mine blocks with silk touch$(li)Enjoy improved performance with RS2
